portfolio_profile_summary_paragraph: Full-stack engineer with experience building .NET (C#) and React applications for thousands of daily users, from legacy migration to greenfield design. Skilled in software architecture, relational databases (PostgreSQL, MSSQL), and identity and access management (OAuth, RBAC). Comfortable owning a service end to end: requirements, support, mentoring, iteration. French native, English C2, motivated to bring rigorous, security-conscious engineering to systems managing structured data at scale.

playground_seo_description: A showcase of experiments and side projects by Nicolas Thouvenin.
